newsitem.title: JAPAN: OLYMPICS-N.KOREA TO JOIN IN NAGANO WINTER GAMES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-N.KOREA TO JOIN IN NAGANO WINTER GAMES.

text.p: North Korea has told the International Olympic Committee (IOC) that it will take part in next year's Winter Olympics in Nagano, Japan, organisers said on Friday.

The Nagano Olympic Organising Committee (NAOC) said in a statement that North Korea was among 70 countries and regions that had notified the IOC of their decision to participate in the 1998 Winter Games.

The number of countries and regions pledging to take part in the Games, scheduled for February 7-22, surpasses the record of 67 set at the 1994 Winter Games in Lillehammer, Norway. The deadline for responding to the IOC's invitation is June 7.

International aid workers have warned that if North Korea, hit by two consecutive years of flooding, fails to receive massive food aid from the world community, thousands of people there could die from starvation.
Stalinist North Korea took part in last year's Atlanta Summer Olympics, ending a three-year absence from international sporting events.
